title: clinopodium chinense
intro: Clinopodium chinense, commonly known as Chinese clinopodium or Chinese sweet woodruff, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the mint family. This plant has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The health benefits of Clinopodium chinense include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it a valuable natural remedy for promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of this plant include relieving pain and reducing inflammation, while its bioactive constituents include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids.
